questions.question: Where has the 14th edition of the India-Russia bilateral naval exercise INDRA 2025 taken place?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 14th edition of the India-Russia bilateral naval exercise INDRA 2025 will take place off Chennai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 14th edition of the India-Russia bilateral naval exercise INDRA will be held from 28 March to 2 April 2025 off Chennai.**
 
• The exercise will be conducted in two phases: Harbour phase (28 to 30 March) and Sea phase (31 March to 2 April).
 
• The exercise will feature naval ships from both nations, including Russian Federation Naval Ships Pechanga, Rezkiy, and Aldar Tsydenzhapov, and Indian Naval Ships Rana and Kuthar.
 
• The exercise aims to enhance maritime cooperation, exchange best operational practices, and strengthen diplomatic ties between India and Russia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• INDRA Exercise Background__

 __
 
• INDRA has been conducted since 2003 and epitomizes the long-term strategic relationship between the Indian and Russian Navies.
 
• The exercise has evolved into a symbol of maritime cooperation between both countries.
 
 
 
• Activities during the Harbour and Sea Phases__
 
 
• Harbour Phase includes SMEEs, reciprocal visits, sports fixtures, and pre-sail briefings.
 
• The Sea Phase features advanced naval drills, tactical manoeuvres, live weapon firings, anti-air operations, and helicopter cross-deck landings.

questions.question: Who was awarded the 2025 Abel Prize?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Masaki Kashiwara**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Japanese mathematician Masaki Kashiwara awarded the Abel Prize 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Recipient of the 2025 Abel Prize**: Masaki Kashiwara, a Japanese mathematician.

 
 
• 
 
**Field of Contribution**:

 
 
• 
 
Algebraic analysis

 
 
• 
 
Representation theory

 
 
• 
 
Development of D-modules

 
 
• 
 
Discovery of crystal bases.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**About the Abel Prize**:

 
 
• 
 
Named after Niels Henrik Abel, a legendary Norwegian mathematician.

 
 
• 
 
Established by the Norwegian Parliament in 2002 to commemorate Abel's 200th birth anniversary.

 
 
• 
 
First awarded in 2003.

 
 
• 
 
Often regarded as the Nobel Prize equivalent in mathematics.

 
 
• 
 
Awarded by a committee in consultation with the International Mathematical Union (IMU) and the European Mathematical Society (EMS).

 
 
• 
 
Includes a cash award and a glass plaque designed by Norwegian artist Henrik Haugan.

questions.question: Every year, March 23 is observed as Martyrs’ Day as a tribute to freedom fighters Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev Thapar, and Shivaram Rajguru. In which year were they executed by the British government?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**1931**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Every year, March 23 is observed as Martyrs’ Day as a tribute to freedom fighters Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev Thapar, and Shivaram Rajguru.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Martyrs' Day** or **Shaheed Diwas** is observed every year on **23 March** as a tribute to freedom fighters **Bhagat Singh**, **Sukhdev Thapar**, and **Shivaram Rajguru**.

 
 
• 
 
They were **executed** by the **British government** on this day in **1931** for assassinating **John Saunders**, a British police officer, in **1928**.

 
 
• 
 
They mistook **Saunders** for **James Scott**, the British police superintendent, who had ordered the lathi charge that led to the death of **Lala Lajpat Rai**.

 
 
• 
 
Bhagat Singh and **Batukeshwar Dutt** set off explosives inside the **Central Legislative Assembly** in **Delhi** in **1929**, and shouted the famous slogan: **"Inquilab Zindabad"** ("Long live the revolution").

 
 
• 
 
Martyrs' Day on **30 January** is a separate observance to mark the assassination of **Mahatma Gandhi**.

 
 
• 
 
The actions of **Singh**, **Thapar**, and **Rajguru** have inspired countless youth and set an example of **individual heroism** and **revolutionary action**.

questions.question: How many journalists were felicitated at the 19th Ramnath Goenka Award for Excellence in Journalism 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**27**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• 19th Ramnath Goenka Awards for Excellence in Journalism awarded by President.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **President Droupadi Murmu** was the chief guest at the **19th Ramnath Goenka Award for Excellence in Journalism 2025**.
 
• The winners were presented with a **citation**, a **trophy**, and a **cash prize** of **₹1 lakh**.
 
• The award honors journalists in **Print/Digital & Broadcast journalism**.
 
• **Mridulika Jha** of **Aaj Tak** won the award for her coverage of the **“Dunki route”**, a method used by youths from Haryana to illegally enter the **United States**.
 
• A total of **27 journalists** were felicitated in **20 categories** at the ceremony held in **New Delhi** on **19 March 2025**.
 
• The **Ramnath Goenka Award** was instituted by the **Indian Express Group** in honor of its founder’s **birth centenary**.
 
• The award, first given in **2005**, recognizes journalists who display **courage** and **excellence** in their work, often in the face of significant **political and economic pressures**.

questions.question: Which RBI digital initiatives were recognized for the Digital Transformation Award 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Pravaah and Sarthi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• RBI awarded digital transformation Award 2025 for digital initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** was awarded the **Digital Transformation Award 2025** by **Central Banking** at London for its digital initiatives.
 
• The two initiatives recognized are **Pravaah** and **Sarthi**, both developed by RBI’s **in-house developer team**.
 
• **Sarthi** (launched in **January 2023**) digitized RBI’s **internal workflows**, enabling secure storage and sharing of documents, improving **record management**, and automating processes.
 
• **Sarthi** integrates task tracking, performance monitoring, and collaboration, replacing fragmented manual and digital processes.
 
• **Pravaah**, launched in **May 2024**, provides a **digitized platform** for **external users** to submit **regulatory applications** to the RBI.
 
• Documents submitted via **Pravaah** are processed and integrated into the **Sarthi database**, ensuring secure handling across RBI offices with centralized **cybersecurity systems**.
